**Actionable comments posted: 0** > [!CAUTION] > Some comments are outside the diff and can't be posted inline due to GitHub limitations. > > **⚠️ Outside diff range comments (2)** > >
> 🟡 Minor · Load categoryValues before deleting a Product. · productService.ts:8-14
> > `src/services/productService.ts:8-14` > > **Load `categoryValues` before deleting a `Product`.** > > `delete` iterates `product.categoryValues`, but `getById` only includes `files`. A product with category values reaches the delete loop with an empty collection, so its row is removed while its category values remain. > > Add `'categoryValues'` to the `include` list in `getById`. > >
> >
> 🟢 Trivial · Guard delete against a missing Product. · productService.ts:9-16
> > `src/services/productService.ts:9-16` > > **Guard `delete` against a missing `Product`.** > > Calling `delete` for an id that does not exist could throw when the code below tries to use it. > >
